item.title: Inflammatory tweets by NYC political staffers point to growing normalization of anti-Zionism
item.description: New report exposing Mamdani campaigner's posts supporting Hamas and propagating anti-Israel conspiracies is only the latest controversy surrounding political operatives in the city The post Inflammatory tweets by NYC political staffers point to growing normalization of anti-Zionism appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump: Regime change in Iran ‘would be the best thing that could happen’
item.description: US president confirms sending second aircraft carrier to Middle East in case 'difficult' Islamic Republic doesn't make a deal, says 'fear' is only thing that will get Tehran to sign agreement The post Trump: Regime change in Iran ‘would be the best thing that could happen’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Ex-hostage reveals she tried to kill herself in Gaza, says seeing footage of protests saved her
item.description: Arbel Yehoud and Ariel Cunio say their captors passed letters between them for several months * Jury deadlocks in trial of anti-Israel Stanford students who occupied university president’s office The post Ex-hostage reveals she tried to kill herself in Gaza, says seeing footage of protests saved her appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: What to do with anti-Zionist Jews? Try talking to them, some US Jewish researchers say
item.description: A poll by a group that calls for 'healthy arguments' on Judaism and Israel finds that many Israel adversaries are knowledgeable, while casting them out is counterproductive The post What to do with anti-Zionist Jews? Try talking to them, some US Jewish researchers say appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Mistrial declared in case of anti-Israel Stanford students who occupied school president’s office
item.description: Jury deadlocks on felony charges against the students, one of whom vows that 'we will continue to fight... because at the end of the day, this is for Palestine'; prosecutors to seek new trial The post Mistrial declared in case of anti-Israel Stanford students who occupied school president’s office appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump administration sues Harvard, accusing it of not cooperating on admissions probe
item.description: Justice Department alleges school 'refused to produce pertinent data and documents,' while university states that it's being targeted for 'refusing to surrender its independence' The post Trump administration sues Harvard, accusing it of not cooperating on admissions probe appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US readying for potential weeks-long military campaign against Iran — sources
item.description: American official says strikes could target Iranian state and security facilities, not just nuclear sites; adds that US fully expects Iran to retaliate, leading to back-and-forth attacks The post US readying for potential weeks-long military campaign against Iran — sources appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Unvaccinated 9-year-old dies of measles, as outbreak mounts in Haredi communities
item.description: Boy pronounced dead after being brought to hospital in critical condition; Health Ministry: 'The vaccine saves lives' The post Unvaccinated 9-year-old dies of measles, as outbreak mounts in Haredi communities appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: A match made in uniform: Couples forged in IDF find love is a battlefield
item.description: Amid early mornings, long deployments and the rigid boundaries of military life, some soldiers discover something the army never intended to provide -- romance The post A match made in uniform: Couples forged in IDF find love is a battlefield appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.description: Speaking at Munich Security Conference, German leader says he has begun talks with France on a European nuclear deterrent; Macron: 'Europe has to become a geopolitical power' The post Merz calls to repair Europe’s rift with US, saying old world order ‘no longer exists’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.
